purpose: Effect and regression cases for authored painterly composition, hard-locked human geometry with finished-frame style integration, explicit three-tier contrast budgets, salient-prop reconstruction, layered colour and subject light, plus restrained relationship-driven tactile depth.

cases.request: 把这张人物照片转成原创绘画动画画面。保留人物身份、动作和红伞，但要用大面积色块、分面笔触和明显材质差异，不能只是照片叠加绘画滤镜。
cases.input_contract: One environmental portrait with a declared identity, pose, and colour anchor.
expected_behavior: Preserve the declared identity, action, subject count, and red umbrella anchor.
Make one thumbnail-visible macro departure plus one supporting move before adding texture.
Reconstruct the subject with readable planes and use different mark grammars for skin, hair, fabric, vegetation, metal, and sky where present.
Fail any result whose source photo remains intact beneath one global paint texture or uniform grade.

cases.request: 把这张明亮雪山与河流照片变成更抽象的绘画画面。保留山、森林、河流的空间关系，但可以合并树木和雪石，不要压成暗夜。
cases.input_contract: One high-key winter landscape without a human focal anchor.
expected_behavior: Keep a high- or mid-key exposure independently from abstraction strength.
Preserve the mountain/forest/river topology while compressing repeated trees and stones into a small set of rhythm groups.
Choose one hero form and one counterform or current, expressed through five to nine macro masses.
Lower non-focal microcontrast and edge density without turning the background into neutral blur.

cases.request: 把这张俯拍海浪做成强烈、抽象但仍能认出浪向的绘画画面。可以夸张主浪和泡沫形状，请对青绿、白色、岩石色的面积与平衡负责。
cases.input_contract: One aerial ocean photograph with a dominant wave direction.
expected_behavior: Preserve the dominant flow and essential coastline or rock adjacency.
Enlarge or simplify the hero wave at thumbnail scale instead of tracing all foam detail.
Assign spatial ownership to the dominant field, structural counter, focal accent, and neutral bridge.
Use directional water marks, broken foam edges, and distinct rock planes rather than one shared texture.

cases.request: 保留人物、山峰、地平线和左右位置，不要把原图改到无关；但可以适度放大山体、重做光形和降低非主体对比度，让画面更有绘画动画感。
cases.input_contract: One environmental portrait with protected composition anchors.
expected_behavior: Treat subject position, landmark position, horizon, depth order, and left-right relationships as protected anchors.
Use anchored enlargement or local overlap changes without relocating the subject or landmark.
Give the focal event two or three attention advantages while keeping context chromatic, unified, and quieter.
Do not confuse source faithfulness with preserving photographic microdetail or contrast distribution.

cases.request: 只给我一段可执行提示词：一个人在雨后的高架桥下，做成大色面、分面结构和材质笔触明显的原创绘画画面。不要生成。
expected_behavior: Return one priority-ordered executable prompt with canvas anchors, macro masses, value groups, colour roles, contrast tiers, material grammars, and anti-filter conditions.
Do not call an image tool or claim that an image was generated, inspected, or passed quality review.

cases.request: 检查这张重制图：构图几乎没变，原照片明暗还在，只是人物、草地、天空和衣服都叠了一层相同油画纹理。它合格吗？
cases.input_contract: One generated remake that retains photographic underpainting with uniform texture.
expected_behavior: Fail the anti-filter gate even if the close-up brush texture is attractive.
Identify missing macro-shape departure, insufficient contrast ownership, and identical cross-material marks.
Recommend one targeted correction that rebuilds large shapes and material differences rather than adding more texture or darkness.

cases.request: 把这张人物与环境照片做成原创建绘画画面，沿用大色块、分面、重新构图和重新配色；只在前后遮挡、衣褶转折、主体道具与前景穿插处增加轻微油画立体感，不能整张图都像厚颜料拼起来。
cases.input_contract: One photo with a focal subject, articulated prop or garment, and foreground/background relationships.
cases.expected_route: Edit Target with Light Tactile Depth
expected_behavior: Use the baseline directorial, colour, shape and material system before any surface height.
Name a small set of spatial depth carriers such as overlaps, contacts, form turns, directional crests or foreground separators.
Keep sky, atmosphere, skin, distant fields and other continuous passages broad, connected and mostly low-relief.
Reject equal-size palette-knife patches, puzzle-piece tessellation, full-frame embossing and relief that competes with the focal read.

cases.request: 检查这张重制图：天空、雪地、衣服和皮肤都被相似大小的凸起颜料块切开，看起来像马赛克或拼图。虽然很有3D质感，但这种立体感合格吗？
cases.input_contract: One generated painterly remake with all-over raised patchwork.
expected_behavior: Fail the light-depth ownership and continuity gates.
Explain that paint height is replacing rather than reinforcing overlap, form, contact and spatial depth.
Preserve the composition and colour system, flatten continuous fields, and retain only mild body on named depth carriers.
Do not recommend more texture, stronger bump, more gloss or smaller repeated tiles.

cases.request: 把这张人物撑波点伞的照片做成强风格绘画画面。人物要认得出来但五官必须更好看、更有神；伞仍然是原来的主色和图案类型，但不要逐片逐点照抄。构图、主体照明和色彩由你主动判断。
cases.input_contract: One environmental portrait with a recognizable person and a salient patterned prop.
expected_behavior: Separate the person's visible identity signature and the prop's semantic anchors from authored design anchors.
Choose one structural primary macro departure with an aesthetic payoff and one supporting move visible at 128–256 px.

Hard-lock facial landmarks, expression, gaze, head-neck attachment, body proportions, pose, limbs, hands, feet, clothing silhouette and contacts; improve beauty only through light, colour, paint grouping and controlled edges inside that geometry.
Use the same light field, colour logic, abstraction family, edge hierarchy, material world, contact treatment and final grade across person and environment.
Preserve prop category, owner/contact, dominant colour and motif family while redesigning silhouette rhythm, panels, repeat grouping, material, highlights and overlap.
Separate local colour, primary illumination, limited environment influence and a restrained final grade.

cases.request: 检查这张结果：人物还能认出来，但脸比原图难看，脖子和下颌连接别扭；伞的每个分片和圆点几乎都照搬，只增加了油画纹理。它合格吗？
cases.input_contract: One generated remake with identity retention but degraded facial aesthetics and literal prop tracing.
expected_behavior: Fail human-geometry and prop-reconstruction gates even if likeness and texture are acceptable.
Restore the exact source landmarks, expression, head-neck geometry and body relationships; correct only paint/light/edge artifacts inside the lock.
Preserve prop semantics and essential motif while redesigning panels, repeat rhythm, highlights, material and overlap rather than adding more texture.
Keep successful composition and colour modules unchanged during the targeted correction.

cases.request: 这张图近看有很多笔触，也写了放大主体、加强云和加浓颜色，但缩小后还是原照片；天空、草地、皮肤和道具都很艳，整体有点脏，背景还像盖了灰雾。请判断问题。
cases.input_contract: One generated remake with several nominal exaggeration axes, no thumbnail-visible departure, global saturation and gray-fog context.
expected_behavior: Fail the macro-departure gate because several minor axes do not replace one decisive structural primary change.
Fail layered colour and chromatic-context gates because local colour, illumination and grade collapse into global saturation and gray fog.
Choose one structural primary departure with an aesthetic payoff, then one supporting move.
Restore source-informed local colours, a neutral bridge, subject/background illumination separation and a restrained final grade while retaining colored material depth in context.

cases.request: 把这张人物在田野里的照片重做成更有作者性的绘画画面。人物本人、表情、姿势、四肢、手脚、衣服轮廓以及人与地面和伞的接触全部不能变；但你可以扩大天空或田野、改变地平线和环境形状，并让主体与背景更有层次。
cases.input_contract: One environmental portrait with a fully visible person and editable surrounding landscape.
expected_behavior: Record the full human hard lock before any directorial change and keep the person as one undistorted unit.

Choose one thumbnail-visible primary change from crop, area, environment scale, negative space, depth, light shape or color-zone restaging, plus one supporting move; never use local human anatomy or pose as the change.
Fill explicit Tier 1/Tier 2/Tier 3 relationships for local contrast, microcontrast, edge density, chroma, hue noise and texture frequency.
Integrate the locked person through the same light, colour, edge, plane, material, contact and grade system as the environment.
Inspect facial landmarks, body proportions, every limb/joint, hands, feet, clothing silhouette and contacts after generation; make one targeted restoration if any drift occurs.

cases.request: 检查这张结果：背景构图和色彩比原图更好，但人物脸型、眼睛位置、手指、膝盖角度和鞋子方向都有变化。整体很漂亮，能算合格吗？
cases.input_contract: One generated remake with successful environment direction but multiple human-geometry changes.
expected_behavior: Fail immediately; an attractive background cannot compensate for facial, limb, hand, joint or foot drift.
Preserve successful environment, composition, colour and material modules while restoring only the exact source-visible human geometry and contacts.
Reinspect the corrected result at mid and close scale and do not call it a pass if any human drift remains.

cases.request: 检查这张结果：人物五官和姿势都没变，但人物仍像原照片，边缘很硬，光线和颜色也与重新绘制的背景不一致，像贴上去的一样。
cases.input_contract: One generated remake with correct human geometry but a photographic or pasted person inside a painterly environment.
expected_behavior: Fail the human style-integration gate even though geometry is preserved.
Keep all human geometry fixed and correct only light/shadow grouping, paint abstraction, edge hierarchy, material handling, contact integration and final grade.
Require person and environment to share one visual system without using a separate mask-like person grade or changing anatomy.
